extension.description: Video, audio, subtitle and system information during playback, with a shortcut to Kodi's native process information and supported Dolby Vision diagnostics. Targeted at CroqueMr LibreELEC DV Beta4 / Kodi 22. No background service, web server or Amlogic VS10 controls.
extension.news: 1.0.0: Initial LibreELEC playback overlay. New identity and artwork; selected formatting code adapted from TinyPPI, with attribution.
